better_answer_example: As an IT undergraduate with a passion for AI engineering, I'm excited about the opportunity to apply my skills in Python, NLP, and model evaluation. In my recent project, I developed a customer support chatbot, focusing on intent identification, flow design, and response testing. Although it was a small project, I learned valuable lessons about teamwork and the basics of AI solution development. One challenge we faced was handling similar questions with wrong responses, but through persistence and collaboration, we were able to resolve the issue. I believe my experience and skills align well with this role, and I'm eager to contribute to the team.
